svg.text: Plate 8 mm, 380 x 440 mm (440 across the frame).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four slots 14 mm wide, 60 mm long, along the frame,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over the crossbars 220 and 480 mm from the joint end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 mm in from the front edge and 50 mm from the back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M12 bolts through the slots into the crossbars.
